messages:
Ava (Design): Quick design check — proposing a new sidebar IA + breadcrumb behavior. TL;DR: group top-level nav into Projects / Inference / Operations / Admin, breadcrumbs show Project > Area > Page. Thoughts?
Sam (PM): I like that. Big constraint: deep links need to be stable. Bookmarks + external links can't break. We'll need redirects and analytics continuity.
Luis (Eng): Agree on redirects. From routing side we should have canonical paths and an explicit redirect map. Suggest patterns like: /console/projects/:projectId/... and server-side 301s for old routes during rollout.
Luis (Eng): Example path layout I'm thinking:
```
/console/projects/:pid/dashboards/:did
/console/projects/:pid/models/:mid
/console/inference/dedicated/:instanceId
# redirects (temporary plan)
/console/dashboards/:did -> /console/projects/:pid/dashboards/:did 301
```
Ava (Design): I put a quick Figma mock here: https://www.figma.com/file/placeholder/nav-ia-v2 — microcopy note: prefer nouns (Observability vs Observe) and keep labels short. Also consider grouping 'Dedicated' under Inference -> Deployments instead of top-level.
Maya (UX Research): We did 6 quick sessions. Users expected Models under Inference, not as a lonely top-level item. Keyboard nav: expanded groups should persist focus and support arrow keys. Breadcrumbs: use clear separators and announce via SR when changed.
Nina (Accessibility): Accessibility nits: add aria-labels to the sidebar toggle, use <nav aria-label="Breadcrumbs"> for breadcrumb lists, and make sure active contrast meets AA. Also ensure focus order when sidebar collapses.
Sam (PM): Also need to keep GA/Amplitude event names stable or provide a migration plan so historical dashboards don't break.
Luis (Eng): Plan: implement route aliasing and server redirects in the API gateway. On the client, when we move a page, do history.replaceState to avoid duplicate pageviews. Will add route-tests to the suite.
Ava (Design): One more UX detail: deep-links into sub-tabs should use query params (e.g., ?tab=versions) rather than hashes so that server can interpret them and analytics capture them consistently.
Nina (Accessibility): That works. For tabs, ensure role="tablist" and aria-selected is used, and update the live region if content loads async.
Ava (Design): Plan: branch nav-ia-v2, update staging by Tue. @Luis (Eng) can you author the redirect map and a small migration script? @Sam (PM) will own analytics sign-off. :calendar:
deploy-bot: Branch created: nav-ia-v2 by ava/design — CI started.
Luis (Eng): I'll open a PR with redirects + route tests today, ETA Wed.
Sam (PM): Thanks — I'll run through staging flows once PRs land and report back with sign-off or notes. :thumbsup:
